note: ChatGPT web composer. Measured live 2026-11-25: while recording, the row exposes ONE toggle button[data-dictation-button="dictating"] labelled 'Stop dictation'; clicking it ends the live capture and leaves the already-streamed text in the composer. There is no separate discard control, so cancelSelector is empty and the shared cancel() falls back to this toggle (C-ASR-4: commit and discard never share a selector). Older 'Submit dictation' and checkmark candidates are kept as fallbacks. Re-verify every entry with probe.js while signed in, then re-run tools/build-extension.js + sync_extension.js and reload the extension. The composer is anchored to the composer form so a page-wide editable is never scraped, and the blue Voice orb is excluded by its label and testid.
